summary: Genius Sports Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing the notice and proxy card for its 2026 Annual General Meeting, to be held at 2:00 p.m. GMT on December 8, 2026, at its London offices and virtually, with a proxy deadline of 2:00 p.m. on December 4, 2026. The Board recommends shareholders vote in favor of each resolution, all to be decided by poll; the accompanying letter comes from the Chair. No transaction, stake, price or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch only for voting outcomes on the proposed resolutions.
